full_page.content:
1944, March 8
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. ( from the Photo-copy)
March 8, 1944
Miss Grace Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. I have somany messages from you unanswered that I am now determined before postponing more to thank you at least. I hope this finds you improved and improv- ing . . . . I have just a few minutes . . .
. The picture I am sending under separate cover was quite ideal, but some one had and accident and broke the glass.
The little frame just fits where I want it I hope you will like the Placque . etc.
God bless all. Do not worry.
Praised be Jesus ,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
